question: Should this protected maintainer-labelled PR be closed as redundant because current `main` already omits `originalLength`, or retained only if its exact merge state still contains the unused declaration?
rationale: Repository policy prevents automatic cleanup of items carrying the protected `maintainer` label, even when the requested change appears already present on current `main`.
